# Unique II Worldwide

Unique II Worldwide is a private aviation ground transportation company founded in 1996 by Marcello Bustamante. We are the official luxury chauffeured partner of the Corporate Aircraft Association (CAA), with home operating bases at Meridian Teterboro (KTEB), Fontainebleau Aviation in Opa-Locka (KOPF), and Business Jet Center at Dallas Love Field (KDAL). Ground transportation reach in over 1,100 cities worldwide.

## Services

- Private FBO Transfers — direct ramp pickup at every major private aviation field
- Luxury Ground Transportation — sedans, SUVs, Sprinters for executive travel
- Charter Bus Service — mini-coach to 56-passenger motor coaches for crews and groups
- Discrete VIP Transportation — NDA-trained, named full-time chauffeurs for principals, talent, and family offices

## Service Areas (full local-led ground)

23 cities: New York City, Westchester, Boston, Nantucket, Washington DC, Atlanta, Miami, Naples, Palm Beach, Dallas, Houston, Austin, Chicago, Denver, Aspen, Salt Lake City, Las Vegas, Scottsdale, Los Angeles, San Francisco, London, Paris, Toronto.

## FBO Network (29 home airports)

Northeast: KTEB (Teterboro), KHPN (Westchester), KBED (Hanscom), KACK (Nantucket)
Southeast: KOPF (Opa-Locka), KFXE (Fort Lauderdale Executive), KAPF (Naples), KPBI (Palm Beach), KPDK (Atlanta DeKalb-Peachtree)
Texas: KDAL (Dallas Love Field), KADS (Addison), KSGR (Sugar Land), KHOU (Hobby), KAUS (Austin-Bergstrom)
Mountain/West: KAPA (Centennial Denver), KASE (Aspen), KSDL (Scottsdale), KSLC (Salt Lake City), KHND (Henderson), KLAS (Harry Reid), KPWK (Chicago Executive), KMDW (Chicago Midway)
California: KVNY (Van Nuys), KBUR (Burbank), KSQL (San Carlos)
DC: KIAD (Dulles)
International: EGGW (London Luton), LFPB (Paris-Le Bourget), CYYZ (Toronto Pearson)

## Differentiators

- Official CAA partner (Corporate Aircraft Association)
- 25+ years under continuous founding-family ownership
- W-2 chauffeurs on payroll — no gig drivers
- Owned, late-model fleet at three home bases
- Real-time tail tracking, FBO coordination, and aviation-first dispatch technology
- 24/7 live reservations and dispatch
- NDA-trained chauffeurs and unmarked vehicles available on request

## Founding

Unique II Worldwide started in 1996 when founder Marcello Bustamante put a single Lincoln Town Car on the road in New Jersey. Three decades later the company runs three operating bases, partners with the Corporate Aircraft Association as an official luxury chauffeured partner, and provides ground transportation in over 1,100 cities worldwide.
